findings.function: convertToAssets, convertToShares, previewDeposit/Mint/Redeem/Withdraw, maxWithdraw, deposit, mint, redeem, withdraw, getXAmountByVestingDuration ... (OpenZeppelin Math.mulDiv in ERC4626 conversions)
findings.source: Math.mulDiv: twos = denominator & (0 - denominator); denominator /= twos; inverse = (3 * denominator) ^ 2; inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse (6 times)
findings.issue: Known P9, here in a small contract where it is most of the text: the Newton steps of the modular inverse are merged pairwise into polynomials (4x - 6dx^2 + 4d^2x^3 - ...) and the reduced denominator (totalSupply + 1) / lsb is re-printed inside every term.
findings.rule: Name each SSA value the bytecode computes once (d' = d / twos; inv0; inv1 ...) instead of substituting it; never expand products of named sums.

notes: Source loop: getUserRedeemsBalance for (191), while. userRedeems(address) copies the storage array of structs to memory and re-encodes it (298, 315; implicit, the first as a loop of field reads, the second a P7 copy). Transient-storage reentrancy guard (transient[0]) and Ownable2Step checks match. stor13 (userRedeems) is unnamed because its getter is unknown to the signature database. 51 ABI functions read.
summary: A small, faithful text with its one loop found; its readability is dominated by the expanded OpenZeppelin mulDiv in every ERC4626 conversion.
